title: Ontology-Driven Control of Conversational Agents with a Use-Case for Job Interview Practice
title_zh: 本体驱动的会话智能体控制及其在求职面试练习中的应用场景

paragraphs.en: 提出基于本体的会话策略设计方法，通过微调LLM在求职面试练习中实现对会话特征的透明控制。 Large Language Models (LLMs) have been widely used as conversational agents in both domain-specific and open-domain situations. In domain-specific context, it is often necessary to adapt those LLMs to obtain conversations with desired characteristics, whether those apply at the level of each response (e.g. for tone or style) or more globally (i.e. at the level of a conversational strategy). Such adaptations are, however, generally realized in an ad hoc way, through specific, non-reusable, and non-transparent developments. In this paper, we propose an ontology-based approach to design conversational strategies that rely on the desired and measured characteristics of textual utterances in the conversation. Through a use case related to job interview practice, we show how this approach can be used to control LLMs to follow the strategy defined in the ontology. To this end, we automatically fine-tune the LLM to improve its compliance with ontologically-defined conversation characteristics. Our results show that training the LLM from formally defined concepts effectively enhances alignment with the requested characteristics. Hence, this work demonstrates how ontology-guided conversation control can be achieved while taking into account multiple, concurrent conversation aspects that are formally and transparently defined.
paragraphs.zh: 提出基于本体的会话策略设计方法，通过对LLM进行微调，在求职面试练习中实现对会话特征的透明控制。大型语言模型（LLM）已被广泛用作特定领域和开放领域场景中的会话智能体。 在特定领域的场景中，通常需要对这些LLM进行适配，以获得具有期望特征的会话，无论这些特征作用于每条回复的层面（例如语气或风格），还是作用于更全局的层面（即会话策略层面）。 然而，这类适配通常以临时的方式实现，通过特定的、不可复用且不透明的开发来完成。 在本文中，我们提出一种基于本体的方法来设计会话策略，该策略依赖于会话中文本话语的期望特征和实际测得的特征。 通过一个与求职面试练习相关的用例，我们展示了如何使用该方法控制LLM以遵循本体中定义的策略。 为此，我们自动微调LLM，以提高其对本体定义的会话特征的遵循程度。 我们的结果表明，从形式化定义的概念出发训练LLM，能够有效增强其对所要求特征的契合度。 因此，这项工作展示了如何在形式化且透明地定义多个并发的会话方面的同时，实现由本体引导的会话控制。
